whyChooseUs: AH Digitizing provides professional embroidery digitizing and vector conversion services with a focus on quality and attention to detail. Every design is manually digitized to achieve clean stitching, precise details, and reliable embroidery results. Our experienced digitizers create high-quality embroidery files optimized for different fabrics, garments, and embroidery needs, helping customers worldwide bring their artwork to life.

faqs.question: How Can I Place an Order?
faqs.answer: You can place an order through our online order form or email by sending your artwork and project details.
steps: Upload your artwork or design directly through our website

faqs.question: What Artwork Can I Submit?
faqs.answer: We accept common artwork formats such as JPG, PNG, PDF, AI, EPS, and TIFF. If you have another file format or image, please contact us before submitting your order to confirm if we can work with it.

faqs.question: What Information Should I Provide With My Order?
faqs.answer: Please provide the design size, artwork, colors, fabric type, required file format, and any special instructions. If you have a reference design, please submit it with your artwork before we start the project.

faqs.question: What Is Your Turnaround Time?
faqs.answer: Most standard embroidery digitizing and vector orders are completed within 4–12 hours. More complex designs may require additional time. Urgent service may also be available upon request.

faqs.question: How Much Does Your Service Cost?
faqs.answer: Our pricing is affordable and straightforward, with flat-rate pricing available for many services. The final price depends on the design and service required. You can contact us or submit your artwork for a quote.  (Get a free quote)

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: Credit/Debit cards, PayPal, and bank transfers are accepted.
